topic: 主动日志轮转与断线补报
title: 真实Zabbix主动日志：断线与未读轮转后逐条核验补报，不能只看最新行
answer:
```python
import re
def log_key(logdir):
 if not isinstance(logdir,str) or len(logdir)>400 or not re.fullmatch(r'/(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/)*[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',logdir):raise ValueError('absolute POSIX directory with simple components required')
 return 'logrt["'+logdir+'/^app[.]log([.][0-9]+)?$",,,20,all]'
```

原题知识说明：
日志读取维护位置与文件识别状态，断线、进程重启和轮转方式会影响恢复；log与logrt对文件更替的处理不同，copytruncate还可能产生竞态。应保存源日志文件序列、轮转时间和可辨识事件ID，对照发送历史及Agent持久状态支持情况，核对每个窗口的连续性。只看最新值可能跳过中间整段，不能把时间最新当完整。用追加、rename轮转、截断、断网和Agent重启组合演练，统计遗漏与重复边界。日志项用于监控不应自动充当可靠审计归档，关键审计日志仍采用独立保全链路。

conversion.original_title: 主动Agent日志项断线后恢复时，为什么检查最新一条日志不足以证明轮转期间没有漏采？

body:
## 操作任务
实现log_key(logdir)。目录须是长度不超过400的绝对POSIX路径，每段只含ASCII字母、数字、下划线或横线，不允许根目录本身、相对路径、点段、空段、逗号或换行；非法ValueError。返回logrt["目录/^app[.]log([.][0-9]+)?$",,,20,all]，以all读取已有内容，并覆盖app.log及数字轮转副本。真实Agent先收before记录，隔离TCP网关再拒绝所有转发；夹具短暂停住此自有Agent，追加未读行后把app.log改名app.log.1并创建更大的新文件，然后恢复Agent但仍阻断传输。服务端此时必须没有新history；恢复转发后逐条核验旧文件未读行和新文件行全部到达且题定五条各一次。不能仅检查最后一行、只匹配当前文件或使用不处理轮转的log key。原主机、item、Agent配置和旧history不改。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实官方传统Agent7.0.32、Server7.0.32、PG15.19、active checks协议、logrt及history_log；仅自有loopback TCP转发与自有进程50毫秒左右的暂停制造确定的未读轮转窗口，不改宿主时钟、网络或身份。BufferSize100且只采五条；连接在转发前被拒绝，不证明任意丢失ACK、长时间断线、缓存耗尽、Agent2或生产Exactly-once。既有固定镜像与只读工具叠加，无安装、构建或拉取镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,re
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import pathlib,subprocess,threading,socketserver,socket,select,time,os,signal
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
class Relay(socketserver.BaseRequestHandler):
 def handle(self):
  if not self.server.enabled:self.server.rejected+=1;return
  try:
   with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',self.server.upstream),timeout=2) as upstream:
    self.request.settimeout(2);upstream.settimeout(2);ends=[self.request,upstream];deadline=time.monotonic()+8
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
     if not self.server.enabled:return
     ready,_,_=select.select(ends,[],[],.1)
     for source in ready:
      data=source.recv(65536)
      if not data:return
      (upstream if source is self.request else self.request).sendall(data)
  except OSError:return
class Gate(socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer):allow_reuse_address=True;daemon_threads=True
with PrivateServer() as s:
 d=s.db;logs=s.root/'active-logs';logs.mkdir();current=logs/'app.log';current.write_text('before-1\n')
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:configure_actual_active_log_rotation_key',flush=True)
 key=task.log_key(str(logs))
 assert isinstance(key,str) and len(key)<=512 and re.fullmatch(r'(?:log|logrt)\["'+re.escape(str(logs))+r'/[A-Za-z0-9_\[\].^$()+?\\|-]+",,,20,all\]',key),'approved directory and bounded log/logrt key grammar required'
 d.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Active log rotation',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,delay) VALUES(1000001,1000000,7,'Rotating application log','"+key+"',2,'1d','0','1s'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001)")
 metadata=d.execute('select hostid,host,name,status from hosts where hostid=1000000');itemmeta=d.execute('select itemid,hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,delay from items where itemid=1000001')
 s.start();gate=Gate(('127.0.0.1',0),Relay);gate.upstream=s.port;gate.enabled=True;gate.rejected=0
 thread=threading.Thread(target=gate.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start();agent=None;err=None
 try:
  conf=s.root/'agent-active.conf';agentlog=s.root/'agent-active.log'
  fields=dict(LogType='file',LogFile=agentlog,PidFile=s.root/'agent.pid',DebugLevel=3,StartAgents=0,ServerActive='127.0.0.1:'+str(gate.server_address[1]),Hostname='training-node',RefreshActiveChecks=1,BufferSend=1,BufferSize=100,Timeout=2)
  conf.write_text(''.join(str(k)+'='+str(v)+'\n' for k,v in fields.items()));err=(s.root/'agent.stderr').open('wb')
  version=subprocess.check_output(['zabbix_agentd','-V'],text=True,timeout=3);assert '7.0.32' in version
  agent=subprocess.Popen(['zabbix_agentd','-f','-c',str(conf)],stdout=err,stderr=err,start_new_session=True)
  def history():
   if agent.poll() is not None:raise AssertionError('Agent exited: '+(agentlog.read_text() if agentlog.exists() else (s.root/'agent.stderr').read_text()))
   return d.execute('select value from history_log where itemid=1000001 order by clock,ns')
  try:s.wait(lambda:history()==[['before-1']],'actual active Agent first log',seconds=25)
  except AssertionError:print('AGENT_LOG',agentlog.read_text() if agentlog.exists() else (s.root/'agent.stderr').read_text(),flush=True);raise
  print('ACTUAL_ACTIVE_AGENT_LOG_FIRST_VALUE_RECEIVED',history(),flush=True)
  gate.enabled=False;time.sleep(.2)
  # Briefly pause this owned Agent so rotation contains unread old-file lines.
  # This is a controlled collection gap, not a host clock or identity change.
  agent.send_signal(signal.SIGSTOP)
  after=['after-1:'+('X'*64),'after-2:'+('Y'*64)]
  try:
   with current.open('a') as out:out.write('offline-1\noffline-2\n')
   current.rename(logs/'app.log.1');time.sleep(.05);current.write_text('\n'.join(after)+'\n')
  finally:agent.send_signal(signal.SIGCONT)
  time.sleep(3)
  assert history()==[['before-1']] and gate.rejected>0,'outage must actually block history transport'
  gate.enabled=True;expected=[[x] for x in ['before-1','offline-1','offline-2',*after]]
  try:s.wait(lambda:history()==expected,'real Agent buffered rotation recovery',seconds=25)
  except AssertionError:print('RECOVERY_HISTORY',history(),'AGENT_LOG',agentlog.read_text(),flush=True);raise
  print('ACTUAL_ACTIVE_AGENT_OUTAGE_ROTATION_ALL_FIVE_RECORDS_ONCE',history(),flush=True)
  assert metadata==d.execute('select hostid,host,name,status from hosts where hostid=1000000')
  assert itemmeta==d.execute('select itemid,hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,delay from items where itemid=1000001')
  assert conf.read_text()==''.join(str(k)+'='+str(v)+'\n' for k,v in fields.items())
 finally:
  gate.shutdown();gate.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
  if agent is not None and agent.poll() is None:
   agent.terminate()
   try:agent.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(agent.pid,signal.SIGKILL);agent.wait(timeout=2)
  if err:err.close()

assert task.log_key('/tmp/another-owned-dir/logs')=='logrt["/tmp/another-owned-dir/logs/^app[.]log([.][0-9]+)?$",,,20,all]'
for value in (None,True,0,'relative','/','/tmp/a,b','/tmp/x/..','/tmp/x/./logs','/tmp/[]','/tmp/x\nlogs'):
 try:task.log_key(value)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('unsafe or unsupported key directory accepted')
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
